newsitem.title: USA: ARV Assisted expects to post loss for Q4.
newsitem.headline: ARV Assisted expects to post loss for Q4.

text.p: ARV Assisted Living Inc said Tuesday it expects to post a loss for its fourth fiscal quarter due to a slight decline in facility occupancy and corporate restructuring costs.

The company said it intends to sell its apartment management operations and take a restructuring charge of about $2 million for divesting the operations, which it said account for about two percent of current revenues.
It said it plans to sell the apartment operations in order to focus on its core assisted living program, consisting of 22 multi-family and senior apartments totaling 2,803 units in seven states.
The company said it had experienced a slight decline in facility occupancy for the fourth quarter ended March 31, 1997 and a slower than projected lease-up of its Beaumont, Texas facility.
"As a result of these factors and the charges it will take in conjunction with its restructuring, the company expects to post a loss for its fourth fiscal quarter," it said in a prepared statement.
